pages.title: Example Electronics — Laptops and Keyboards
pages.main_text: Example Electronics sells laptops and keyboards online.

pages.title: Pro Laptop X — Laptop for Professionals
pages.meta_description: A laptop with a fast processor and large display.
pages.main_text: The Pro Laptop X is a laptop priced at INR 95000. It ships with 16GB RAM, 512GB storage and a fast processor, making it excellent for programming and software development. Popular with professionals and developers. Battery life lasts a full day.

pages.title: Campus Laptop 13 — Laptop with 16GB RAM
pages.meta_description: Laptop with 16GB RAM and long battery life for students.

headings.text: Great for students on a budget

pages.main_text: Campus Laptop 13 comes with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage, priced at INR 58000. Long battery life for a full day of classes. Ideal for students.

pages.title: Wireless Keyboard Pro — Keyboard for Professionals
pages.meta_description: A wireless keyboard with backlighting and mechanical switches.

headings.text: Built for programming and typing comfort

pages.main_text: The Wireless Keyboard Pro connects over Bluetooth and features RGB backlighting and mechanical switches with a full-size layout. Priced at INR 4500. Battery life lasts two weeks on a single charge. Popular with professionals and programmers.

pages.title: Gaming Keyboard Mech — Keyboard for Gaming
pages.meta_description: A wired mechanical gaming keyboard with RGB lighting.
pages.main_text: The Gaming Keyboard Mech is a wired keyboard with linear mechanical switches and RGB backlighting, priced at INR 3200. Tenkeyless layout for extra mouse space. Popular with gamers.
